description: This file defines a wizard for creating invoices from event registrations in an OpenERP/Odoo module. It includes form definitions, a method to generate invoices based on registration data, and a wizard interface with states for processing and listing invoices.

classes.name: make_invoice
classes.description: Wizard class for creating and listing invoices related to event registrations.

methods.name: _makeInvoices
methods.description: Generates invoices from event registration data, performs validation, creates invoice lines, and updates registration states.

methods.name: _list_invoice
methods.description: Returns an action to list created invoices in a form view.
